meta.title: 3 Days in Da Nang & Hoi An | Vietnam Travel Guide
meta.description:
Planning a trip to Vietnam? Then you have to add the very beautiful and vibrant city of Da Nang in Vietnam. Da Nang and Hoi an are two such places that are on the must visit list of all the tourists visiting vietnam. From the beautiful Ba Na Hills where the world famous Golden Hand Bridge is to the newly opened attraction of Vin Wonders which is a massive Animal safari and theme park located near Hoi An.

🎟️ Activities & Tickets

This video contains affiliate links as well for booking trips, activities and services mentioned in the video and you can use my code "CHALOLETSGO" on the klook app or webiste for 10% off on all purchases. Some of the useful links of the activities recommended in this video are here...

Sunworld Ba Na Hills: https://s.klook.com/c/Ny657o681q


In this video you will find out everything that you need to know on how to plan you Da Nang trip for 3 days including where to stay in Da nang or Hoi an, All the ticket prices and tours that you can do while you're here. If you Love to party or love shopping then I have also included some must visit places in this video guide for Da nang and hoi an.

Highlights of the Itinerary:
🏙 Sunworld Ba Na hills with Golden hand bridge with buffet Lunch
🌸 Han River Night Cruise
🏖 Coconut Island Boat Ride
🚍 Marble mountain tour
🎈Nightlife and Shopping in Da nang
🎢 Vin Wonders Nam Hoi An 
🐼 River Safari at Vin wonders 
⛵️Visit to Hoi An and Boat Rides
🍜 Stay Novotel Premier Han River & Vinpearl Resort & Golf Nam Hoi An

Valuable resources for your Vietnam Trip:

I stayed at the very comfortable Novotel Premier Han River for 2 Nights
& I also stayed at the Vinpearl Resort & Golf Nam Hoi An for 1 Night
